fields.rule: Source label, legal employer, company group and host are distinct. Group aliases need a reviewed registry.
fields.current: issuer plain text nonempty 4339; exact strings 91; normalized entity/group registry absent

fields.rule: Official organization address or explicit organizational evidence only. Never derive from job location, domain or currency.
fields.current: no common field; headquarters evidence not systematically collected

fields.shape: array of country_or_area assertions plus city/region/remote
fields.rule: Preserve all locations on one posting; location count does not create new opportunities. Preserve source scheme/code/label.
fields.current: flat country 2977 and location 3826; Workday primary alpha2 2955 with 39 source codes; not canonical SQL geography

fields.shape: eligibility AST for where support may be used
fields.rule: Destination or permitted study country differs from applicant nationality and issuer country.
Nationality groups require source-specific membership version; do not infer from location or residency.
fields.current: no canonical rule; nationality wording lexical hits 420, not reviewed coverage

fields.rule: Country of residence, ordinary residence, immigration status and work authorization remain separate operands.
fields.current: DAAD 4 application_scope country filters preserved in current_application_status JSONB; exact nationality unresolved

fields.rule: Mandatory internship inside a fellowship is an activity requirement, not a second opportunity. Taxonomy label alone does not determine financial method.
fields.current: SQL internship 4010, scholarship 240, other 74, admission_funding 15; current SQL enum lacks loan and student_job

fields.rule: Internship, permanent and full-time occupy different axes. Preserve incompatible raw code and label pending review.
fields.current: Bosch native experienceLevel and typeOfEmployment present 17; not common canonical fields

fields.rule: One award can combine a fee waiver and living stipend. Do not collapse them into a single benefit label.
fields.current: canonical purposes/methods/amount-currency-unit 0; paid_student_employment flag 7, amount/currency null

fields.rule: Travel duty, equipment used at work and financial-industry job tasks do not establish support purposes.
Keep source payment_label. Allowance/stipend does not automatically establish wage or nonrepayable grant. Interest subsidy or loan repayment benefit is not a new loan.
Staff benefits or dependent tuition assistance are not automatically benefits of the student opportunity.
A cap is not an exact amount. A year is not a month. Bare $ leaves currency_code unknown unless separately supported. A fee waiver percentage is not a cash amount.
Keep original JSON pointer and text extraction hash. Text offsets attach to that extraction version.

rules: Zero classified rows does not imply real-world absence.
An empty native array, absent key or no keyword hit is unknown, not explicit_none.
explicit_none requires a source negative with scoped quote.
A source country filter is stored under that role; do not copy into nationality.
Related, broader and narrower aliases require distinct mapping relations; only reviewed exact equivalents substitute automatically.
Unresolved required eligibility returns unknown and requests additional facts instead of false.

dedup_contract.rule: Same reviewed company and same reviewed role are one user-facing family. Country or location arrays do not multiply families. Distinct cohorts/conditions remain child variants. Uncertain role or organization aliases enter review.
dedup_contract.execution: Parent owns implementation. This file does not apply merges or certify provisional groups.

promotion_rule.field_absence_policy: Preserve raw input and unknown until mapping review; never backfill from title alone when semantic ambiguity remains.
